topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I walked past my neighbor's house the other day, and something was different—subtle, yet it caught my eye. I noticed a sleek, brand-new electric car parked in the driveway, the kind that costs more than most people’s houses. I started to wonder. Then, pieces of the puzzle began falling into place. The recent renovation, the fancy clothes that seemed a bit too expensive to be a one-time splurge. It all made sense now. I can't help but think about all the quiet times I've seen them, tending to their garden or working on DIY projects. They always seemed so content, so unassuming. It’s funny how appearances can be so misleading. Now, I’ll definitely have to rethink our next chat over the fence, decide how to navigate knowing a little more than I did before.
